text: On Staten Island, the French-Canadian model Danielle Breton brings home a man she met on a television prank show, and the next morning [her twin Dominique stabs him to death|threat|the enemy within]. From the apartment across the way, the reporter Grace Collier [sees him write help in his own blood|trigger|seeing or hearing too much] on the window, but the police find only Danielle, alone. Grace [presses on by herself|who_suffers|those who step in], following a hidden body, a file on Canada's first conjoined twins and Danielle's ex-husband Emil to a remote mental hospital.
